scope: Eight historical failures investigated using the new protected artifact; first acceptance frames remain authoritative. No causal product fix or native rerun follows this audit.
observed_limits: CDP cached Document body is zero bytes on all targeted roles; empty SHA256 cannot prove source/CSS/font-byte parity. DOM CSS fingerprints and every retained computed style match.
DOM SHA256 differs while normalized input fields and retained geometry/style/text hashes match. The artifact cannot enumerate the differing markup; unrecorded structure cannot be ruled out.

Later WebContents readback pairs all match, but each differs from its own original ADB crop by hundreds of thousands of RGB pixels; it is a separate diagnostic path/time, not proof that the original rendering surface matched.

All 36 SurfaceView PixelCopy crops match their own original screenshot. This rules out a simple ADB PNG-only discrepancy at the observed times; it does not locate the cause before/inside Flutter composition.

13 of 36 roles change exactly one pixel after CDP observations with unchanged measured element geometry/styles. The bundled observation sequence has several operations; no single operation is causally isolated.
Fixed same-role fresh-view A/A observations differ on five of eight cases. They rule out a candidate-endpoint-only explanation for those observations, without proving GPU nondeterminism.
